These fixtures are **constructed**, not captured from a real FortiGate: their
shape follows the documented FortiOS REST API responses (top-level `results`,
`session_id`, `completed`, `ready`, `version`, `serial`, …) and the documented
traffic-log fields (`srcip`, `srcmac`, `sentbyte`, `rcvdbyte`, `sentdelta`,
`rcvddelta`, `duration`, `eventtime`, `action`, `sessionid`, `logid`).
Replace them with real (anonymized) captures once API access is available.
